lyrics:
Tere bina saansein adhoori si lage
Khamoshi bhi mujhse kuch kehne lage
Dil har pal tera hi naam kahe

Safar mein tanha reh gaya hoon
Teri yaadon ka bojh seh gaya hoon
Maahi tu kahin bhi ho, paas lage

Rang badalte rahe jazbaat mere
Ishq ne likhe anjaam mere
Toot kar bhi tujhmein hi raha

Apna sa lagne laga hai tu
Har darr se ladne laga hoon yun
Tere saath hi ab jeena hai

Dil ke rang mein tu hi basa
Har dua mein tera hi nasha
Ishq mera tujhse hi saja

Pagal sa ho gaya hoon main
Tere pyaar mein kho gaya hoon main
Khud ko bhi bhool baitha hoon

Tu saath ho toh sab mil gaya
Khwaabon ka shehar saj gaya
Phir aur kya chahiye mujhe

Dil mera kamla ho gaya
Teri ek muskaan pe kho gaya
Ishq ne sab kuch chura liya

Tere saath chalne laga hoon
Har darr se nikalne laga hoon
Tu mila toh raasta mila

Tere ishq mein lutt putt gaya
Khud ka bhi pata bhool gaya
Dil bas tera hi ho gaya

Tum kya mile dil muska gaya
Zakhmon ka har dard mit sa gaya
Mohabbat ne sab kuch sikha diya

Dhadkan bhi aaj jhoom uthi
Har saans nayi si dhoop bani
Junoon mein hi jeena seekha

Gir ke bhi uthna seekh liya
Andheron se ladna seekh liya
Zinda rehna hi jeet hai

Tanhaayi mein bhi shor sa hai
Dil ka dard kuch aur sa hai
Khud se hi ladta raha hoon

Dil jhoom sa gaya aaj
Teri yaadon mein kho gaya aaj
Mohabbat phir zinda hui

Dil ne phir se tujhko chaha
Toot ke bhi tera hi raha
Ishq mera adhura sa raha

Khairiyat se ho tum kahin
Dil bas yahi dua kare
Door rehkar bhi paas ho tum

Muskurane ki wajah tum ho
Toot jaane ka sabab bhi tum ho
Zindagi tumse hi judi

Agar tum saath ho toh kya gham hai
Har dard bhi jaise kam hai
Tera hona hi kaafi hai

Kuch toh hai tujhse raabta
Dil jaane na ye kya baat hai
Har pal tujhi se waasta
